mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate level exceeding 0.5% per annum indicates active monetary tightening, increasing the cost of capital and reducing equity valuation multiples, which results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending growth and corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous unemployment rate above 8.0% and industrial production index below 95.0 indicates severe economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth and increasing risk aversion, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.0 and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: An inflationary monetary tightening cycle (CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS > 0.25) indicates aggressive central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225 and FEDFUNDS > 0.25.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 750 thousand units per month signal robust consumer demand for housing, driving economic expansion and corporate earnings growth, which generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST exceeds 750.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production index below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous housing starts increase above 750 thousand units and retail sales growth exceeding 400,000 million dollars signals strong consumer spending, accelerating economic growth and corporate profit expansion, which yields positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 750 and RSAFS > 400000.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (housing starts above 750 thousand units and GDP growth rate exceeding 13500 billion dollars), overheated consumer demand increases market correction risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The hypothesis fails if the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 750 and GDPC1 > 13500.
